prompt.project_info: Candid Instagram-style rooftop portrait during golden-hour sunset with an aspirational urban lifestyle mood.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long straight blonde hair and natural highlights, fair-to-light tan skin, delicate features, subtle makeup, tortoiseshell cat-eye sunglasses and small gold hoops.
prompt.composition_elements: She sits on a white towel on a wooden rooftop deck or lounger, knees bent, one arm behind for support and head turned slightly over the shoulder toward camera. Wear the supplied muted dusty-blue or slate-blue string triangle bikini with thin straps, side ties and subtle metal hardware. Include bare feet, angular metal structures and glass high-rise cityscape.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm orange-pink golden-hour sunlight with soft sky fill, gentle rim light on hair and skin, long soft shadows and optional subtle lens flare.
prompt.technical_specs: 50–85mm equivalent, shallow depth of field, sharp subject with softly blurred city background, realistic smartphone or mirrorless candid capture, slight grain, natural colors, horizontal social portrait framing.

She wears a muted dusty-blue or slate-blue string bikini with triangle top, thin straps, high-cut bottoms with side ties and subtle metal hardware accents. Use golden-hour sunset light, warm orange-pink illumination, soft sky fill, gentle rim light on hair and skin, long soft shadows, optional subtle lens flare, 50–85mm perspective, shallow depth of field, slight grain, natural colors and a relaxed aspirational summer-city mood.
